message.content:
This document describes **Project Maya**, a local LLM inference stack for running large MoE models on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Quantization tiers (Maya-XS/S/S24/M/L)**
- Named by model first, then tier (bits kept per expert). Setup IDs like `glm-maya-s24`; legacy names still work.
- GLM-5.3-Flash quants built from Z.ai's FP8 release using FP8 statistics; retain the MTP drafting block.
- Sizes 94.7–156.3 GB; accuracy vs FP8 ranges 97
